_comment: Right-click context help. Transcribed from EVANHELP::_static_fleet_screen_help_list (evanhelp.cpp:153-166, twelve entries, s_help_box {help_id, x1, y1, x2, y2} orion2.h:993), installed by EVANHELP::Set_Fleet_Screen_Help_List_ (evanhelp.cpp:378-407) at entry (flt1.cpp:549), on every loop iteration (:802) and after the detailed ship view (:624). `native` is the original's 640x480 rectangle and is provenance only - HD resolves each region from its own boxes. Regions are tested in order and the first hit wins, like fields::Check_Help_List_ (fields.cpp:2924-2932).
hd_extension: The help popup auto-sizes to its text and scrolls when it cannot fit. The original draws a fixed box and lets FMTPARA wrap into it at a fixed 339 px (TEXTBOX::Draw_Help_Entry_, textbox.cpp:307); at four HD resolutions a fixed box either wastes half the screen on two lines or clips a long entry. Marked once per file, here, and in core/helppopup.py.
_no_screen_wide_entry: THE LIST HAS NO SCREEN-WIDE ENTRY, and that is load-bearing rather than an omission. A right click outside every region returns -field_idx and not -1, because _mouse_cancel_disabled is set once by Main_Screen_ (mainscr_main.cpp:281) and nothing clears it (fields.cpp:1360, :1513) - which is how a right click on an OWN big icon reaches CMBTDRW1::Detailed_View_Ship_ (flt2.cpp:929-933). An occupied icon slot carries no help rectangle for exactly that reason.
_no_help_over_the_map: There is no entry over the inset galaxy map (15..319, 52..233): the original gives it none, so `inset_map` has none here.
_dynamic_entry: Help 360 is APPENDED after these twelve (help_list_count starts at 12, evanhelp.cpp:379), so every entry below wins against it. Its shape depends on how many big icons were added: with none, one rectangle (0x158, 0x35)-(0x24f, 0x161) = (344, 53)-(591, 353); otherwise one per EMPTY slot i = added..19 at (0x156 + 64*(i%4), 0x34 + 64*(i/4))-(0x196 + …, 0x72 + …) = (342 + 64c, 52 + 64r)-(406 + 64c, 114 + 64r). NOTE THE PITCH: the help slots step 64 while the icons step 62 x 60 (flt2.cpp:122, :126) and are 58 x 57 (:288-290). Transcribed as it stands, not unified. It cannot be a static region because it is per-slot and count-dependent, so FleetsScreen.open_help_at appends it after this table, in the engine's own order.
